title: Shattered Envelopes in Bloom
description: Two broken, translucent glass-like envelopes float above a dense pile of deep crimson rose petals. The envelopes are cracked with golden lines and contain faint circular patterns, set against a dark, smoky background with faint golden script and floral line art.
